subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. B sits fourth to the right of R. Only two people sit between T and D when counted from the left of T. A sits third to the left of C. S is an immediate neighbour of C and D. How many people sit between B and S when counted from the left of S?
solution: Given: A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. 1) A sits third to the left of C.
